Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to manage the certificate and key directories.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-serts--cert_directory"></a>`cert_directory`

Data type: `Stdlib::AbsolutePath`

The directory where certificates should be stored. Defaults to /etc/ssl/certs, or /etc/pki/tls/certs on RedHat systems.

Default value: `'/etc/ssl/certs'`

##### <a name="-serts--key_directory"></a>`key_directory`

Data type: `Stdlib::AbsolutePath`

The directory where private keys should be stored. Defaults to /etc/ssl/private, or /etc/pki/tls/private on RedHat systems.

The directory where letsencrypt stores its data. Defaults to /etc/letsencrypt.

Default value: `'/etc/letsencrypt'`

## Defined types

### <a name="serts--autopair"></a>`serts::autopair`

Automatically create a certpair using Certbot for the given fqdn. Use serts::certpair instead of this to manage the resulting cert and key files.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `serts::autopair` defined type:

* [`title`](#-serts--autopair--title)
* [`ensure`](#-serts--autopair--ensure)
* [`fqdn`](#-serts--autopair--fqdn)
* [`alt_names`](#-serts--autopair--alt_names)
* [`manage_cron`](#-serts--autopair--manage_cron)
* [`cron_output`](#-serts--autopair--cron_output)
* [`certname`](#-serts--autopair--certname)
* [`renewal_options`](#-serts--autopair--renewal_options)

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--title"></a>`title`

The name of the resource, which should be the fully qualified domain name (FQDN) for the cert.

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

Whether the certificate and key should be present or absent.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--fqdn"></a>`fqdn`

Data type: `String`

The fully qualified domain name of the url the cert is for. By default, this is the title of the resource,
but if the title does not contain a dot, the system's domain will be appended to it.

Default value: `($title =~ /[.]/) ? { true => $title, false => "${title}.${facts['networking']['domain']}"`

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--alt_names"></a>`alt_names`

Data type: `Array[Stdlib::Host]`

An array of additional fqdns that should be included. If the fqdn matches
the system's fqdn, additional alt names will be looked up from hiera.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--manage_cron"></a>`manage_cron`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to manage a cron job to renew the certs.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--cron_output"></a>`cron_output`

Data type: `Optional[Enum['suppress', 'log', 'none']]`

Whether to output the cron job's output. Defaults to 'suppress', which means no output unless there is an error.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--certname"></a>`certname`

Data type: `String`

The name of the cert/key to create. By default, this is the same as the fqdn.

Default value: `$fqdn`

##### <a name="-serts--autopair--renewal_options"></a>`renewal_options`

Data type: `Hash`

Extra options to set in the cert configuration files.

Default value: `{}`

Represents a certificate and its key. You might want to use serts::certpair instead.

##### <a name="-serts--cert--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

Whether the certificate and key should be present or absent.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--title"></a>`title`

The name of the resource, which should be the fully qualified domain name (FQDN) for the cert.

##### <a name="-serts--cert--owner"></a>`owner`

Data type: `String`

The owner of the certificate and key files.

Default value: `'root'`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--group"></a>`group`

Data type: `String`

The group of the certificate and key files.

Default value: `'root'`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--directory"></a>`directory`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::AbsolutePath]`

The directory where the certificate should be stored.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--filename"></a>`filename`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The name of the certificate file.  If not given, it will be
determined based on the hostname like "server.crt.pem".

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--exclude_filetype"></a>`exclude_filetype`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to exclude the filetype from the filename. Defaults to false, which
means the file will be named like "server.crt.pem". If true, it will be named like "server.crt".

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--server_hostname"></a>`server_hostname`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to use 'server' as the filename if the hostname matches the system's hostname. Defaults to true.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--mode"></a>`mode`

Data type: `Stdlib::Filemode`

The file mode for the certificate file.

Default value: `'0444'`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--fqdn"></a>`fqdn`

Data type: `String`

The fully qualified domain name of the url the cert is for. By default, this is the title of the resource,
but if the title does not contain a dot, the system's domain will be appended.

Default value: `($title =~ /[.]/) ? { true => $title, false => "${title}.${facts['networking']['domain']}"`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--fullchain_cert"></a>`fullchain_cert`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to use the fullchain.pem file from Certbot instead of cert.pem.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--cert--certname"></a>`certname`

Data type: `String`

The name of the letsencrypt certpair to use. By default, this is the same as the fqdn.

Default value: `$fqdn`

### <a name="serts--certpair"></a>`serts::certpair`

Represents a certificate and its key.

#### Examples

##### Basic usage with default parameters

```puppet
serts::certpair { 'myhost': }
```

##### Specify custom owner and group

```puppet
serts::certpair { 'myhost':
  owner => 'appuser',
  group => 'appgroup',
}
```

#### Parameters

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::AbsolutePath]`

The directory where the certificate should be stored.

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--key_directory"></a>`key_directory`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::AbsolutePath]`

The directory where the key should be stored.

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--cert_filename"></a>`cert_filename`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The name of the certificate file.  If not given, it will be
determined based on the hostname like "server.crt.pem".

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--key_filename"></a>`key_filename`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The name of the key file.  If not given, it will be
determined based on the hostname, like "server.key.pem".

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--exclude_filetype"></a>`exclude_filetype`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to exclude the filetype from the filenames. Defaults to false, which
means the files will be named like "server.cert.pem" and "server.key.pem". If true, they will be named like "server.crt" and "server.key".

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--server_hostname"></a>`server_hostname`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to use 'server' as the filename if the hostname matches the system's hostname. Defaults to true.

Data type: `Stdlib::Filemode`

The file mode for the key file.

Default value: `'0400'`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--fqdn"></a>`fqdn`

Data type: `String`

The fully qualified domain name of the url the cert is for. By default, this is the title of the resource,
but if the title does not contain a dot, the system's domain will be appended to it.

Default value: `($title =~ /[.]/) ? { true => $title, false => "${title}.${facts['networking']['domain']}"`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--alt_names"></a>`alt_names`

Data type: `Array[Stdlib::Host]`

An array of additional fqdns that should be included. If the fqdn matches
the system's fqdn, additional alt names will be looked up from hiera.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--fullchain_cert"></a>`fullchain_cert`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to use the fullchain.pem file from Certbot instead of cert.pem.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--ignore_autopair_warning"></a>`ignore_autopair_warning`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to ignore a warning if a Serts::Autopair resource is already defined for this fqdn.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--certname"></a>`certname`

Data type: `String`

The name of the letsencrypt certpair to use. By default, this is the same as the fqdn.

Default value: `$fqdn`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--include_chain"></a>`include_chain`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to include the CA trust chain in a default location; the cert_directory as ca_bundle.pem.
Does nothing if fullchain_cert is true.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--certpair--renewal_options"></a>`renewal_options`

Data type: `Hash`

Extra options to set in the cert configuration file.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-serts--keychain--fullchain_cert"></a>`fullchain_cert`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to use the fullchain.pem file from Certbot instead of cert.pem.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--keychain--alt_names"></a>`alt_names`

Data type: `Array[Stdlib::Host]`

An array of additional fqdns that should be included. If the fqdn matches
the system's fqdn, additional alt names will be looked up from hiera.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-serts--keychain--exclude_filetype"></a>`exclude_filetype`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to exclude the filetype from the filename. Defaults to false, which
means the file will be named like "server.keychain.pem". If true, it will be named like "server.keychain".

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-serts--keychain--server_hostname"></a>`server_hostname`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to use 'server' as the filename if the hostname matches the system's hostname. Defaults to true.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-serts--keychain--certname"></a>`certname`

Data type: `String`

The name of the letsencrypt certpair to use. By default, this is the same as the fqdn.

Default value: `$fqdn`

##### <a name="-serts--keychain--key_first"></a>`key_first`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to put the private key before the certificate in the keychain file. Defaults to true.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-serts--keychain--filename"></a>`filename`

Data type: `String`

The name of the keychain file.  If not given, it will be
determined based on the hostname like "server.keychain.pem".

Default value:

```puppet
$exclude_filetype ? {
    true    => "${fqdn}.keychain",
    default => "${fqdn}.keychain.pem"
```
